Eternal Rests are excellent against [[wraith]]s and [[vampire]]s as they are silver threaded and have [[Ghost Touch]] and [[Lesser Undead Bane]]. The [[Silver]] attribute and their greater availability over the prized [[Devout Handwraps]] might be attractive for [[Path of Inevitable Dominion]] Monks.

Metal-studded handwraps drop randomly in game, possibly making it easier to get a crafted/specialized set.
